robustness.gate: good requires the OOS hurdle set AND every trailing window AND the bootstrapped-tape check

evaluation_protocol.note: Crypto book trained on 80% of each symbol's daily history; the last 20% is reported as final_holdout and never used for selection. Candidates are ranked on mean return per trade with a profit-factor floor, not hit rate, then the finalists are re-run on two anchored forward folds and the winner is the one whose worst fold survived. Profiles are then re-run on trailing 5/7/10y slices and on block-bootstrapped tapes of the same symbol's returns. All of these reuse the same underlying history, so they measure regime dependence and path dependence, not independent evidence of future returns.
